## What a student cannot do today

## What you are proposing

## Which part of the kit this belongs in

- [ ] A new skill in `payload/skills/` — loaded on demand, so cheap to add
- [ ] A rule in `payload/rules/` — loaded every turn, so it must always apply
- [ ] A worked example in `payload/examples/`
- [ ] A reference in `payload/references/`
- [ ] Installer or script behaviour
- [ ] Something else

## Why it belongs there rather than in `AGENTS.md`

`AGENTS.md` is re-sent on every turn, so anything that does not always apply
should be a skill instead. If you are proposing an `AGENTS.md` change, say why
it must always be in context.
